description: Trigger-test scenarios: a realistic user request and the skill expected to fire once the domain is loaded. Run: bash evals/run-trigger-tests.sh. Validate offline: node evals/check-scenarios.mjs. prompt is English; prompt_fi is the Finnish variant, present for at least one scenario per domain because descriptions keep Finnish legal terms as secondary keywords and those have to keep triggering too. known_miss = a scenario known to skip the skill in headless mode — reported as a warning, not a failure.

scenarios.prompt: Fix this reference into the correct form: "section 7 of the Local Government Act 410/2015 says that..."
scenarios.prompt_fi: Korjaa tämä viittaus oikeaan muotoon: "kuntalain 410/2015 pykälässä 7 sanotaan, että..."
scenarios.note: Regression guard: this skipped the skill in June 2026, after which a short-task sentence was added to the description. If it misses again, a description tweak is not enough.

scenarios.prompt: A summons from the district court arrived in the post today. Where do I start?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Sain tänään postissa haasteen käräjäoikeudesta. Mistä aloitan?
scenarios.note: Known headless miss: the model answers directly instead of calling the skill. Triggers more reliably in interactive use. The most dangerous miss in the suite — engagement-intake maps the deadlines first, and a direct answer can burn an appeal window. The domain AGENTS.md is the backstop.

scenarios.prompt: What does chapter 3 section 5 of the Employment Contracts Act say about non-compete clauses? Check the wording currently in force.
scenarios.prompt_fi: Mitä työsopimuslain 3 luvun 5 § sanoo kilpailukiellosta? Tarkista voimassa oleva sanamuoto.

scenarios.prompt: Explain this contract term to my client in everyday language: "A party is liable for indirect damage only where the damage was caused by gross negligence or intentionally."
Summarise the Supreme Court's recent precedent on summary dismissal of an employment relationship and pull out the ratio decidendi for our own matter.
Go over this draft opinion before I send it to the ministry — find the risks and the gaps.
We have twelve supplier agreements. Put the termination and liability terms side by side, one row per agreement, and show me where each cell comes from.
I have to write a government bill for the ministry. What does the general part have to contain and in what order?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Minun pitää kirjoittaa ministeriölle hallituksen esitys. Mitä yleisperusteluihin kuuluu ja missä järjestyksessä?

scenarios.prompt: In statutory text, how do I write the section sign, subsection numbers, percentages and euro amounts correctly?
Our municipality has to give an opinion on the ministry's draft bill by the end of the month. Help me analyse the proposal and write the statement.
scenarios.prompt_fi: Kuntamme pitää antaa lausunto ministeriön lakiluonnoksesta kuun loppuun mennessä. Auta analysoimaan ehdotus ja kirjoittamaan lausunto.

scenarios.prompt: Go through this non-disclosure agreement and tell me which terms are risky for us.
scenarios.prompt_fi: Käy tämä salassapitosopimus läpi ja kerro, mitkä ehdot ovat meille riskialttiita.

scenarios.prompt: Draft a service agreement for a Finnish customer: scope, pricing, liability cap and termination.
We are planning a system that scores job applicants automatically. Do we need an impact assessment and what is our lawful basis?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Suunnittelemme järjestelmää, joka pisteyttää työnhakijat automaattisesti. Tarvitaanko vaikutustenarviointi ja mikä on käsittelyperuste?

scenarios.prompt: A former employee has asked for everything we hold on them. How do I answer and by when?
Is the AI system we use to pre-screen job applicants a high-risk system under the EU AI Act?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Onko rekrytoinnin esikarsintaan käyttämämme tekoälyjärjestelmä korkean riskin järjestelmä EU:n tekoälyasetuksen mukaan?

scenarios.prompt: When do the AI Act obligations start to apply to us and how large can the penalties be?
My employer ended my employment during the trial period by text message and gave no reasons. Was that lawful?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Työnantajani purki työsuhteeni koeajalla tekstiviestillä ilman perusteluja. Oliko tämä laillista?

scenarios.prompt: We are planning to lay off thirty people at the plant. What does the co-operation procedure require and what are the time limits?
The municipality rejected my building permit application. How and within what time can I challenge the decision?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Kunta hylkäsi rakennuslupahakemukseni. Miten ja missä ajassa voin valittaa päätöksestä?

scenarios.prompt: A journalist has asked our agency for a document that contains a company's pricing. Do we have to hand it over?
Our client wants to take a supplier to the district court over an unpaid invoice. What has to go into the application for a summons?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Asiakkaamme haluaa haastaa toimittajan käräjäoikeuteen maksamattomasta laskusta. Mitä haastehakemukseen kuuluu?

scenarios.prompt: We lost in the district court. By when do we have to declare dissatisfaction and will we need leave for continued consideration?
We are incorporating a limited company and I need the articles of association plus the paperwork for the first board meeting.
scenarios.prompt_fi: Perustamme osakeyhtiötä ja tarvitsen yhtiöjärjestyksen sekä ensimmäisen hallituksen kokouksen asiakirjat.

scenarios.prompt: Three founders are splitting the equity. Draft the terms on vesting, leaver clauses and drag along.
Our company will not be able to pay its invoices next month. What are the options — restructuring, bankruptcy or a voluntary arrangement?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Yrityksemme ei pysty maksamaan laskujaan ensi kuussa. Mitkä ovat vaihtoehdot: yrityssaneeraus, konkurssi vai vapaaehtoinen järjestely?

scenarios.prompt: A customer still has not paid an invoice from two years ago. How do I stop it becoming time-barred and what can I charge for chasing it?
We want to launch a product under a new name. How do I check that it can be registered and that it does not clash with an existing mark?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Haluamme lanseerata tuotteen uudella nimellä. Miten tarkistan rekisteröitävyyden ja sekaannusvaaran aiempaan merkkiin?

scenarios.prompt: A departing employee took our customer list and pricing model with them. What can we do about it?
How is a group contribution treated in the taxation of the parent company and the subsidiary?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Miten konserniavustus käsitellään emoyhtiön ja tytäryhtiön verotuksessa?

scenarios.prompt: After a tax audit we received a reassessment decision with a punitive increase. How do we challenge it and by when?
Our agency is putting cleaning services out to tender for four years. Which procedure should we use and is the EU threshold exceeded?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Virastomme kilpailuttaa siivouspalvelut neljäksi vuodeksi. Mikä hankintamenettely valitaan ja ylittyykö EU-kynnysarvo?

scenarios.prompt: We lost a tender and the comparison of bids looks wrong. Is there still time to take this to the Market Court?
My client has been called in for questioning as a suspect next week. How do we prepare and what are their rights?

scenarios.prompt: We are expanding production at the plant. Does that need a new environmental permit or an amendment to the existing one?
scenarios.prompt_fi: Laajennamme laitoksen tuotantoa. Vaatiiko se uuden ympäristöluvan vai nykyisen luvan muuttamisen?

scenarios.prompt: We bought a detached house last spring and moisture damage has now come to light. What can we do against the seller?

scenarios.prompt: The tenant is three months behind on rent. Can I end the tenancy and how is that done?

scenarios.prompt: Can we require our resellers to stick to a fixed retail price?

scenarios.prompt_fi: Neuvottelemme lainajärjestelystä. Käy läpi kovenantit ja vakuuspaketti: yrityskiinnitys ja takaus.

scenarios.prompt: Is our accounting firm an obliged entity, and what does knowing the customer require in practice?

scenarios.prompt_fi: Haluan laatia testamentin, jossa lapseni saavat vain lakiosansa ja loput menee puolisolleni.

scenarios.prompt: A customer wants to return an item bought from our webshop twenty days ago. Do we have to accept it?

scenarios.prompt_fi: Tarvitsen kaksikieliseen sopimukseen vakiintuneet ruotsinkieliset vastineet termeille "osakeyhtiölaki" ja "yhtiöjärjestys".

scenarios.prompt: A resident wants to deal with our bilingual municipality in Swedish. What are we obliged to provide and in which language must the decision be issued?
